content: 'Itsahaki meta Xeweka
Merikɨtsɨ 'Apɨrahami kani'ukiratsitɨkaitɨniri waɨkawa wiyari kanexeiyakaitɨni, Yawé Kakaɨyari kaniparewiekaitɨni naimekɨ.
Hikɨ 'Apɨrahami 'ukiratsi meripaitɨ miparewi kaniuta'inieni, kiena naime mɨti'uximayatsiriekai tita mɨrexeiyakai, mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —Neteuritɨa keneutame'i,
Yawé hɨxie yurikɨ yakenetineutahɨawi, kemɨ'ane kwie meta muyuawi mutawewi, kename 'uka 'ena kiekame Kanani peka'iwitɨtɨani neniwe
'Itsahaki, matsi pekaniyemieni nemarema wahetsɨa, muwa neniwe 'ɨyaya mayani pekananuyewaumɨkɨ.
Ti'uximayatame mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —¿Perutsɨ xɨka 'uka ne'utɨma mamie kaheyuwaɨriyani 'ikɨ kwieyaritsie paitɨ? ¿Kamɨtsɨ neramie 'aniwe neranuwitɨni wakie paitɨ?
'Apɨrahami mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —Hawaikɨ, neniwe pepɨkahewitɨkɨni muwa paitɨ,

Yawé Kakaɨyari muyuawi mutawewi nekie pɨnetseheyewitɨ ne'iwama wahetsɨa, mɨpaɨ netihɨritɨatɨ: «'Anuiwarima nepɨwayetuirieni 'ikɨ kwie», mɨkɨ yuniuki tuayame kananunɨ'amɨkɨ 'ahamatɨa mɨmatsi'anuwitɨnikɨ, 'ekɨ pemeyɨwekaxɨanikɨ 'uka pemawitɨni neniwe 'Itsahaki hetsiemieme.
Xɨka 'uka 'a'utɨa mamie kaheyuwaɨriyani, 'ekɨ pepɨxɨne kenemerahɨawe, peru neniwe pepɨkahewitɨkɨni muwa paitɨ.
Hikɨ ti'uximayatame 'Apɨrahami teurieyatɨa kaneutameni, mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe kename yurikɨ yatikayani kemɨtihɨritɨa.
Hikɨ kameyutsixi kaniwarukuha'aritɨani tamamata meyupaɨmeme 'Apɨrahami tewamama, meta waɨkawa 'imikierite katiniukuha'aritɨani, kaneyani Nakuxi manukateitsie Metsuputamiya kwieyaritsie.
Mana nuaka kiekari warita haputsu 'aurie yukameyutsixi kaniwarukatuani. Hikɨ kaniukutaikaire, kepauka 'ɨimarixi mematihanɨwetsie kanaye'ani.

Hikɨ ti'uximayatame mɨpaɨ katiniuyutanenewieni: «Yawé, 'Apɨrahami neti'aitɨwame Kakaɨyarieya, waɨkawa nepɨmatsiwawirie hikɨ 'aixɨa nemɨtiyurienikɨ, 'Apɨrahami nekutsiyari kepemɨtinaki'erie yaketineuyuri.
Ne 'ena nepuwe haa matineika newatakwewietɨ, 'ena kiekatari waniwema memayekɨnirɨme metihanɨnike.

Keneupitɨa 'iya 'uka kemɨ'ane mɨpaɨ nemɨtitahɨawe: “Neuxei 'aye'ɨ kenanakahani 'etsiwa nemanuharenikɨ”, mɨkɨta mɨpaɨ kenetiuta'eiya: “Kenanutihareka, 'akameyutsixita nekaniwatiharitɨamɨkɨ”, mɨkɨ 'uka kehɨkɨtɨni pemenayexei 'Itsahaki hetsiemieme mati'uximayatsiriwame. 'Ana mɨpaɨ nepɨretimani kename yapetiuyuri pe'inaki'erie 'Apɨrahami neti'aitɨwame».

Hikɨ yunenewietɨ karanunɨwekaku Xeweka kaniuxeiya, 'akanamiekaitɨni yuye'ɨ 'anakayetɨ. Xeweka Wetueri kaniniweyatɨkaitɨni, Wetuheri kaniwaniwetɨkaitɨni Mirika Nakuxi hamatɨa, Nakuxi 'Apɨrahami 'iwaya.
Mɨkɨ 'uka witsipɨti'ɨimarikai, pɨkawikiekai, 'uki pɨkamaikai 'akuxi. Mɨkɨ haa matineika nuaka kaniutihanɨni. 'Ari pɨyemieximekai
hikɨ ti'uximayatame kaniutanautsa hepana, mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —¿'Etsiwa 'ekɨ pekanetiuharitɨawe haa 'aye'ɨta miemekɨ?
'Uka mɨpaɨ katinita'eiya: —Kenanuhareka. Yuye'ɨ 'anakahanaka kanenutiharitɨani.
Kepauka ti'uximayatame 'anuharekuri, Xeweka mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —Nekaniwatihanɨimɨkɨta 'akameyutsixi wahetsiemieme memɨtiharenikɨ kememɨteuhariku.
Hikɨ tewaxi mematiharewetsie 'ikatuaka, waɨkawamexɨa kanakunuani hanɨnetɨ memɨte'atiharewetsie 'ikatu'atɨ, yunaitɨ memɨtiharenikɨ kameyutsixi.
'Apɨrahami ti'uximayatsiriwame kanixeiyakaitɨni, mɨpaɨ tiku'eriwatɨ xɨka'aku Yawé tiyurienekaitɨni, 'aixɨa 'anemekɨ makunuanikɨ.

Kepauka kameyutsixi memɨte'utahayewaxɨ meharetɨ, ti'uximayatame huru nakɨtsayari hewati'ɨka tsurieyatsie kaniyewirieni 'ataxewime kɨramuyari raheteme, meta huru matsɨwayari kaneimaniriexɨani hutame, xeitsienituyari kɨramuyari raheteme, ti'uximayatame mɨpaɨ katinita'iwawiya:
—Neuxei, ¿kemɨ'ane 'ekɨ pepɨraniwe, 'apaapa kie meyekani 'aumɨ reyɨwe?
Mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ katinita'eiya: —Ne Wetuheri nepɨniweya, Mirika meta Nakuxi waniwe,
mana xemetiheni peyɨwe meta mɨaxa waɨkawa pexɨawe kameyutsixi wahetsiemieme.
Hikɨ ti'uximayatame kaniutitunumakeni Yawé pamɨpariyutsi kaniupitɨani
mɨpaɨ 'utaitɨ: «'Aixɨa pepɨtiuka'iyari Yawé 'Apɨrahami neti'aitɨwame Kakaɨyarieya, pe'inaki'erietɨ pepɨkatihayewa meta 'aixɨa pepɨnetiuye'atɨa 'iwamama wahetsɨa».
Xeweka kaneyani 'unautsarɨmetɨ yumaama hetsɨa, mana katinitaxatɨani kemɨreiyuriekai.
Xeweka xeime yumatsika kanexeiyakaitɨni Rawani titewakame, mɨkɨ 'unautsarɨmetɨ kanayeyani ti'uximayatame heuwaumieka, haa matineika 'akuxi mɨkɨ kaniukateitɨni.

Rawani yu'iwa nakɨtsa kaniuxeirieni meta matsɨwa metatsiere kani'enieni tikuxatakaku ti'uximayatame kemɨrehɨawekai. 'Ayumieme kanayeyani ti'uximayatame heuwaumieka, haputsu matiniere kanitaxeiya, yukameyutsixi wahamatɨa.

Mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —Kɨmɨ, 'ekɨ 'aixɨa pepɨ'itɨarie Yawé yametipitɨakaku. ¿Titayari 'ena peti'akuhayeikawani kiekari warita? Neri 'aixɨa nepɨrekuyuri kiita xemeyehenikɨ, meta 'akameyutsixi wahetsiemieme.

Hikɨ ti'uximayatame kiepa kaniye'ani. Yapauka Rawani kameyutsixi kaniwaruti'ikapieni mɨaxa kaniwarutimini, meta haa kaniwaruhanitɨani ti'uximayatame meta mɨwarawitɨkɨkai yu'ɨkatetsie memauyuhauxixɨanikɨ.
Kepauka memɨtekwanikekai 'Apɨrahami ti'uximayatameya mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: —Ne, nepɨkatikwani yanetayɨmeke titakɨ nemɨtikuyɨane. Hikɨ Rawani mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —Yakeneutayɨkikuta.
Ti'uximayatame mɨpaɨ katinitsutɨani: —Ne 'Apɨrahami ti'uximayatsiriwame nekanihɨkɨtɨni.
Yawé waɨkawa 'aixɨa kaniyurieka kaniparewieka. Katinikupinirieka muxatsi, wakaitsixi, huru, pɨrata, te'uximayatamete 'ukitsi 'ukari, kameyutsixi, meta puxuri.
Meta neti'aitɨwame 'ukiratsitɨtɨri yu'ɨya Tsara hamatɨa xeime nunutsi mekanayexeiya, neti'aitɨwame yuniwe naime katiniupitɨani.
Hikɨ neti'aitɨwame mɨpaɨ pɨnerehɨritɨa: “Neniwe pepɨkakuwitɨtɨwani 'ena kiekame kananeutsixi waniwe, nemanukatsie.
Matsi pɨta kenemie ne'iwama memanu'uwatsie, mana kenetiwawa 'uka neniwe 'ɨyaya mayanikɨ”.
Ne mɨpaɨ nekatineitahɨawe neti'aitɨwame: “Neuxeitsɨ. ¿Peru xɨka 'uka kaheyuwaɨriyani ne 'utɨma mamie?”
Hikɨ mɨpaɨ nerahɨawe: “Yawé nehamatɨa puyeika, mɨkɨ 'ahamatɨa yuniuki tuayame panunɨ'ani, 'aixɨa 'anemekɨ pemakunuanikɨ pemeikaxeiyakɨta 'uka neniwe hetsiemieme nepaapa tɨɨriyamama wahetsɨa.
Xɨka ne'iwama mekaheitaunieni 'uka, mɨpaɨ 'ekɨri pepɨkaraye'atɨani kepemutayɨ neri waɨriyarika nepɨkamatsipitɨani”.
»Kepauka haa matineika nemunua mɨpaɨ neputayɨ: “Yawé 'Apɨrahami Kakaɨyarieya, xɨka mɨpaɨ matinakeni, waɨkawamekɨ nepɨmatsiwawirie 'aixɨa ketineuyuri 'aixɨa nemɨrakunuanikɨ.
'Ena nepuka, neta'ikwewatɨ haputsu matinieretsie. Xɨka xewitɨ 'ɨimari hayeyani kuhanɨnetɨ, mɨpaɨ nepɨtitahɨawe: ‘Neuxei, 'Etsiwa keneneuharitɨa 'aye'ɨta mieme’,
xɨka kemɨ'ane mɨpaɨ mɨtayɨni: ‘Kenanuhareka 'ekɨ, nekaniwatihanɨimɨkɨta kameyutsixi wahetsiemieme’, mɨkɨ kehɨkɨtɨni 'uka pemanayexei Yawé, neti'aitɨwame nu'aya hetsiemieme”.
»'Akuxi nekaranunɨwekaku neyunenewietɨ, Xeweka nekaniuxeiya mana 'amiekame yuye'ɨ 'anakayetɨ. Hikɨ kaniutihanɨni haputsuta, mɨpaɨ nekatineitahɨawe: “Neuxei, keneneuharitɨa”.
Mɨkɨ yapauka yuye'ɨ 'anakahanaka mɨpaɨ kanetinetahɨawe: “Kenanutihareka 'ekɨ, meta 'akameyutsixi nekaniwatiharitɨamɨkɨ”. Mexi ne neheharekai mɨkɨta nekameyutsixi kaniwaretiharitɨani.
Hikɨ nekaneita'iwawiya: “¿Kemɨ'ane pepɨraniwe?” Kepauka mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ mɨnereta'ei: “Wetuheri nepɨniweya, Nakuxi Mirika waniwe”, ne tsurieyatsie nekaneiyewirieni nakɨtsa meta matsɨwa hutame nekaneimini,
hikɨ nekanetitunumakeni Yawé pamɨpariyutsi nekanepitɨani, 'Apɨrahami Kakaɨyarieya, 'aixɨa mɨnetiuye'atɨa 'uka nemɨtaxeiyakɨ 'iwamama waniwetɨme neti'aitɨwame nu'aya hetsiemieme.
Hikɨ, yaxekeneteneutahɨawi xɨka 'aixɨa xetekakɨnikuni xe'inaki'erietɨ neti'aitɨwame, metatsiere yaxeneteneutahɨawi xɨka katixaɨtɨni. Netari kenemɨyɨaneni».
Hikɨ Rawani Wetuheri hamatɨa mɨpaɨ mekaniutiyuani: —Xɨari Yawé matsi mɨpaɨ paine, tame huu temaitɨkani tepɨkayɨwawe meta tixaɨ.
Mana puka Xeweka kenanuwitɨki mati'aitɨwame nu'aya 'ɨyaya kanayeimɨkɨ, heitseriemekɨ Yawé kemaine.
Hikɨ kepauka 'Apɨrahami ti'uximayatsiriwame mɨpaɨ mɨtiutahɨawarie, kaniukatunumakeni kananakatutsire Yawé hɨxie.
Hikɨ katinewatipini hurukɨ mɨtiwewiyatɨka meta pɨratakɨ metatsiere 'ixurikite mɨraye'atɨka Xeweka katiniupitɨani. Yaxeikɨa matsikaya meta maamaya katiniwayetuirieni 'imikierite.

'Anari mɨkɨ meta mɨwarawitɨkɨkai mekateniukwani mekateniu'ieni, mana mekanikuheteitɨni wahetsɨa. 'Uxa'arieka ximeri kepauka memanuku'ui, 'Apɨrahami ti'uximayatsiriwame mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: —Nekanakunuamɨkɨtsɨari neti'aitɨwame hetsɨa.
Peru Xeweka matsikaya meta maamaya mɨpaɨ mekaniutiyuani: —Tamamata tukari 'akuxi ke'ukunuani Xeweka, 'anake tsepa metɨa.
Ti'uximayatame mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: —Neuxeitsɨ xepɨkanetsi'ukununuitɨwani, 'aixɨa 'anemekɨ nemakunuanikɨ Yawé yapɨtiuyuri, 'ayumieme xekeneneupitɨa nemɨyemiekɨ neti'aitɨwame kie.
Hikɨ mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ mekaniutiyuani: —Xeweka tepɨta'iwawiya ketayɨni.
Mɨkɨ me'ita'inieka mɨpaɨ mekatenita'iwawiya: —¿Petiyemie 'ikɨ 'utɨa? Xeweka mɨpaɨ katiniwaruta'eiya: —Huu.
Hikɨ mekanipitɨani Xeweka mɨyemiekɨ, meta 'ukaratsi yamɨti'ɨwiyakai mitaweriyaxɨ 'Apɨrahami ti'uximayatsiriwame 'utɨa meta memeweiyakai.
Hikɨ Kakaɨyari mekaniutawawirieni Xeweka hetsiemieme 'aixɨa miyurienikɨ mɨpaɨ me'utiyuatɨ:
Hikɨ Xeweka meta memɨte'ita'uximayatsirieni me'anutiyaxeka kameyutsixi wahetsie mekanekɨne 'Apɨrahami ti'uximayatsiriwame 'utɨa. Mɨpaɨ Xeweka katinewitɨkieni, 'ana kanayeyani.
Hikɨ 'Itsahaki kaninuakaitɨni haputsu matinieretsie «'Amuyeika Mɨnetsixeiya» mɨtitewatsie, 'anatsɨ Nekexi mɨrakutewatsie kaniuyeikakaitɨni.
Merikɨtsɨ taikai kanikuyani yeuta. Hikɨ yapauka kameyutsixi kaniwaruxeiya me'aye'axɨaximeme mematiteitsie.
Yaxeikɨata Xeweka 'Itsahaki kaniuxeiya, 'ixeiyaka kananakayani kameyutsie
ti'uximayatame mɨpaɨ katiniuta'iwawiya: —¿Kemɨ'ane pɨyɨane mana yeuta matimie tahepa? Ti'uximayatame mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: —Neti'aitɨwame kaniyɨaneni. Hikɨ Xeweka kaneuyuku'eima yɨhɨxie 'ixurikikɨ.
Hikɨ ti'uximayatame 'Itsahaki naime katiniutaxatɨani kemɨrakunua.

Hikɨ 'Itsahaki Xeweka 'ixuriki kiiyarita kaneutawitɨni maamaya muyehupukaitsie Tsara, kanitiwitɨni waɨkawa 'inaki'erietɨ, 'ɨyaya kanayani. Mɨpaɨ 'Itsahaki yu'iyaritsie katiniuyɨnɨtɨani maamaya mumɨkaikɨri.
